## Ready checklist

Before moving this Issue to **Ready**:

- [ ] The objective is clear.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are explicit.
- [ ] Critical dependencies are available or an approved fallback is documented.
- [ ] Required scientific/technical evidence is available or the task explicitly defines how it will be verified.
- [ ] Documentation impact has been considered.
- [ ] The task is independently reviewable and no larger than `L`.
- [ ] The task belongs to the Development Cell scope.
